utterances.text: Hello Mr. Johnson, we are seeing you today for your 6-month blood pressure check. How are you feeling?
Overall feeling fine doctor. No headaches, dizziness, or chest discomfort.
Are you taking your Lisinopril 10mg daily as prescribed?
Yes, taking it every morning with breakfast.
Great. Blood pressure today is 126 over 82, heart rate is 72 beats per minute. Physical exam shows regular heart rate and rhythm.
Your hypertension is well-controlled. Continue Lisinopril 10mg, order routine basic metabolic panel, and follow up in 6 months.
